items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like Tex Beneke and all these players.

ctx.x: Well maybe it needs to be documented, maybe people need to know.

I don’t know the chronology, but here’s the thing: We were playing over in West Memphis, and these white bands would come to the Peabody and these hotels, and they would play. Like Tex Beneke and all these players. And they had guys who wanted to jam, they wanted to cut loose after this hotel dance, playing “dah-dah-dah-dah-dah...”
